value.rationale: Uniform-hyperedge order is the source model’s chief interaction-scale parameter. The full rational occupancy law and exact minimal seven-agent reversal show that a natural environmental response is not monotonically improved by bigger groups. The density crossover constants specify a robust set of cooperative fractions with a decline from size 2 to 3 followed by a rebound at large sizes, giving a substantive comparison distinct from existing simulations of cooperation frequency.
